title: PARDUS Uragano EVO gravel bike review
notes: Exact reviewed build: HS carbon frame, 700x45C maximum, SRAM Apex AXS 1x with X1 Eagle AXS rear derailleur and 11-50T cassette, PW3 DB wheels, 40C Terra Trail tires, 9.65 kg without clipless pedals and historical ¥23,999 official retail. The ride review calls the frame tuning stiff on coarse gravel but provides no measured protocol.
